risk_matrix.risk_description: Executing physical validation now would require DB connection and migration execution before the non-productive DB environment is confirmed.
risk_matrix.mitigation: Block execution until environment readiness, credentials, approval, snapshot, rollback, and evidence ledger are verified.

risk_matrix.risk_description: Readiness design is documentary and preserves all productive authority flags as false.
risk_matrix.mitigation: Keep scope to readiness design only; prohibit environment creation, DB/Supabase connection, migration execution, SQL modification, observer, source connection, and real table read.

risk_matrix.risk_description: Holding preserves safety but leaves the environment readiness gap unaddressed.
risk_matrix.mitigation: Use only if readiness cannot be designed safely; otherwise prefer readiness design.
